<div class="card-body">
'''Stormtrooper Utility Belt''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ストームトルーパー・ユーティリティ・ベルト</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して、任意の帝国軍かエイリアンに配備する。そのキャラクターの戦闘力と没収値に＋１。デススター上であれば、戦闘力と没収値は（＋１ではなく）＋２となる。</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-207o-SWCA.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Stormtrooper Utility Belt (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Stormtrooper-Utility-Belt-C1G.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国軍ストームトルーパーの標準支給品。ロープやフックなど、さまざまな緊急用品を装備する。反乱軍は、帝国軍から奪ったこの万能ベルトを自分たちで使用していた。</span>''<ref name="jp1-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Stormtrooper Utility Belt.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on any Imperial or alien. The character is power and forfeit +1. On the Death Star, the bonus is +2 instead.

'''Lore:''' Standard issue for Imperial stormtroopers, carrying rope, hooks, and other emergency supplies. Rebels used belts they captured from the Empire.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' On the [[Death Star]] the Japanese prints +2 instead of +1; the English prints +2.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Stormtrooper Utility Belt]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
